items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: And Bully Hall, and these fellows. DESVERNY was one of them, was one of the guys around there that he went to the war in the 15th as a Buck Private.

ctx.x: But nobody was able, amongst the black boys like Johnny and Mal and Bob Hewlitt, was a legendary character around there. He was a big gangster. And Bully Hall, and these fellows. DESVERNY was one of them, was one of the guys around there that he went to the war in the 15th as a Buck Private. When he came back, was a Second Lieutenant. He got decorated right on the field.

So that's what happened. And then, when I come out of Baron's -- here's another chance in my life, and I'm showing about the chances that they had in those days, it was a show, it was the second company of "Plantation Days". Was being organized. And they were looking for a music director. Well, now, I had never been in a pit in my life.
